toy: Found in a nursery that was not anyone's nursery.
Won at a fair that closed early.
Kept on a high shelf, by decision.
Wrapped as a present, never unwrapped.
Left behind at a birthday with no cake.
jewelry: Taken off in a hurry, before the wedding.
Passed down, with a warning, to a niece.
Pawned twice by the same person.
Found in a coat that was not theirs.
Polished weekly by someone who denies it.
Engraved, then the engraving was sanded off.
instrument: Played at a funeral, then at a christening.
Last heard at an attic window.
Carried over three borders in a loaf of bread.
Retired from a band that never reformed.
Practised at midnight by a neighbour.
book: Borrowed from a library, never returned.
Read aloud to an empty room.
Left on a train seat, still warm.
Inherited with the house, as a condition.
Dog-eared at a page nobody admits to.
relic: Dug up while someone was planting beans.
Hung over a door for luck, then taken down.
Surrendered at an estate sale, wincing.
Bequeathed in a will to 'whoever asks'.
Brought home from a holiday, regretted.
Kept in a drawer that wouldn't close.

owner: A widow swears she never owned it.
Three owners, one funeral between them.
The previous owner sent a thank-you note.
Sold by a very tidy, very nervous man.
Its last owner insisted on cash.
ominous: Nobody would say why it was sold.
The seller wiped their hands afterward.
The last owner moved the furniture away from it.
It was bought, and then bought back.
